propositions: Two live DC harness test assertions fail because they expect 'OK:' stdout line output from the sync canonical route, but sync deliberately suppresses this output per __main__.py:437 gate condition.
The 'OK:' suppression is intentional and documented in docs/exit-codes.md and ADR 0092; commit c87afedba8 re-pointed the cells at the sync route without updating the assertions.

The canonical sync route emits BRIDGE_STATE: converged on stderr and conditional RECON telemetry lines (outbound_differ total, inbound_differ total, batch_outcome per mutation) to stdout/stderr instead of the OK: summary.
Asserting only BRIDGE_STATE: converged is insufficient for zero-write idempotence validation because the route emits this line for both convergent and mutating passes.

The fix requires re-pointing assertions at the actual sync route outputs: converged pass needs BRIDGE_STATE: converged on stderr, while zero-write assertion needs converged state plus both differ totals=0 plus zero batch_outcome lines.
Unit-testable predicates must be extracted to a new dependency-free module to enable testing against synthetic output without live Jira credentials or network.
